verdict.rationale: Drata is a compliance SaaS platform, so an official MCP server applies, and the evidence shows one: a first-party 'Drata MCP — Setup & Usage Guide' help article, a probe confirming an official MCP server is documented there, and developer docs stating it enables AI agents to interact with Drata and manage controls through natural language. Coverage is thin, with only article titles and a short marketing line rather than detailed content. missing for 10: details of exposed tools/scope, transport and auth setup specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Enable AI agents to interact with Drata. Automate compliance workflows and manage controls through natural language.
